maudhui: (1) The President shall be paid such salary and other remuneration, and on retirement he shall receive such pension, gratuity or allowances as may be determined by the National Assembly, and the salary, other benefits, pension and gratuity shall be charged on the Consolidated Fund of the United Republic and shall be paid in accordance with the provisions of this Article. (2) The salary and all other payments due to the President shall not be reduced while he is in office in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution.
